evidence.claim: Whether Gelfond's constant e^π is transcendental was raised in the context of Hilbert's 7th problem. Gelfond first proved it in 1929.
In 1934 Gelfond and Schneider independently proved the more general Gelfond–Schneider theorem.

Approximating real numbers by quadratic irrationals is an established topic in Diophantine approximation, e.g. Davenport & Schmidt, 'Approximation to real numbers by quadratic irrationals', Acta Arith. 13 (1967) 169–176.
